rules.rule: Views don't start processes or touch the file system; that work belongs in Services.
Services and Models don't import SwiftUI (the core stays UI-free).

Nothing runs while idle: no repeating timers, polling or animations when nothing is changing. Custom animation is capped at 30 fps and stops when hidden; updates from child processes are throttled to a few per second.
UI state is @MainActor; process and file work runs off the main actor.
Anything from a child process, a web page or the network is validated before use.
A behavior change or bug fix comes with a Swift Testing test in Tests/DannyTests.
